starter_files.contents:
# Inventory Management System

Run with `dotnet run`. Use domain methods to protect stock invariants rather than allowing arbitrary field mutation.

## Done when

- [ ] Model products and their identifiers
- [ ] Add/remove stock while rejecting negative quantities
- [ ] Search and sort inventory using collections and LINQ
- [ ] Record a movement history and persist changes
